description: This source file defines the HomeFragment class, which implements the main Android TV home screen UI. It manages a top navigation bar, banner rail, and content rails, handling layout, focus management, and responsiveness. The code includes mock data generators for banners and content items to facilitate UI development and testing.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment for the Android TV home screen, managing navigation, banners, and content rows.

classes.name: ContentItem
classes.description: Data class representing individual media content with ID, title, and image URL.

classes.name: ContentRow
classes.description: Data class representing a row of content items with a title.

classes.name: MockContentData
classes.description: Object providing static methods to generate mock content data for UI testing.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and initializes view binding.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets up brand label, top navigation, banner rail, and content rails after view creation.

methods.name: setupBrand
methods.description: Configures the company brand label with styled text and accessibility label.

methods.name: setupTopNav
methods.description: Initializes the top navigation bar with categories and search icon, handling focus and key events.

methods.name: setupBannerRail
methods.description: Creates a banner carousel with mock banners, responsive sizing, snapping, and focus management.

methods.name: setupContentRails
methods.description: Generates mock content rows for display in vertically scrolling rails with focus handling.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Cleans up view binding on fragment destruction.
